SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.status = 'C'

SELECT CASE
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
         WHEN AVG(A12) < AVG(A13) THEN '1996'
         ELSE 'Equal'
       END AS higher_unemployment_year,
       AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996
FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM disp AS d
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
      WHERE a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
        AND l2.date LIKE '1997%'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date >= '1993-01-01'
  AND a.date < '1994-01-01'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND a2.date >= '1993-01-01'
        AND a2.date < '1994-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (
      SELECT MIN(date)
      FROM trans
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03'

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND t.date = '1998-10-14'

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25'

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id IN (
        SELECT d2.client_id
        FROM card c
        JOIN disp d2 ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id
        WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
    )
)

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH biggest_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM biggest_loan)
  AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.date = '1998-09-02'
  AND t.amount = 5100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND date(c.birth_date) = '1976-01-29'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC, a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE lower(A3) = 'south bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT t.balance
         FROM trans t
         WHERE t.account_id = tl.account_id
           AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
         ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_later,
        (SELECT t.balance
         FROM trans t
         WHERE t.account_id = tl.account_id
           AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
         ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_earlier
    FROM target_loan tl
)
SELECT 100.0 * (balance_later - balance_earlier) / NULLIF(balance_earlier, 0) AS increase_rate
FROM balances

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS dist
    ON dist.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE lower(dist.A3) = 'east bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000

SELECT l.loan_id,
       d.A2 AS district,
       d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60

SELECT c.district_id AS district_id,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.A12, 0)) AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp dp
      WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp dp
      JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
      WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id
  )

SELECT d.A3 AS district, COUNT(*) AS active_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
ORDER BY active_loans DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT A3 AS branch_location, A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997'

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold'

SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month,
       AVG(amount) AS average_credit_card_amount
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date >= '2021-01-01'
  AND date < '2022-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%m', date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
      FROM trans t2
      WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND LOWER(dist.A3) = 'south bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'

SELECT AVG(d.A15)
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account AS a
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'classic'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)

SELECT d.A15
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532

SELECT a.district_id
FROM "order" AS o
JOIN account AS a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000

SELECT DISTINCT ca.type
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 13539

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541

SELECT d.district_id, d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY account_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.client_id
FROM `order` AS o
JOIN disp AS d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT t.*
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'junior'
  AND c.issued >= '1997-01-01'

WITH eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE dist.A11 > 10000
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_women
FROM eligible_clients

SELECT
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
      WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id
        AND c.gender = 'M'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals_after_1995
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date > '1995-12-31'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'North Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'East Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM district

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND UPPER(type) IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT')
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY type

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM trans
   WHERE account_id = 3
     AND type = 'VYDAJ'
     AND k_symbol = 'SLUZBY') AS statement_request_count,
  (SELECT k_symbol
   FROM trans
   WHERE account_id = 3
     AND type = 'VYDAJ'
     AND ABS(amount) = 3539
   LIMIT 1) AS aim_of_debit_3539

SELECT strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
WHERE client_id = 130

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT l.amount, l.payments, l.status
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992

SELECT
    t.balance AS balance,
    CASE c.gender
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'man'
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'woman'
        ELSE c.gender
    END AS owner_gender
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d4
  ON d4.account_id = t.account_id
 AND d4.client_id = 4
JOIN disp AS downer
  ON downer.account_id = t.account_id
 AND downer.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
  ON c.client_id = downer.client_id
WHERE t.trans_id = 851
LIMIT 1

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 9

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.type = 'debit'
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM disp AS d
      WHERE d.client_id = 617
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
  AND di.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY c.client_id
ORDER BY MAX(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS male_customer_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND ca.type = 'junior'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE di.A3 LIKE '%Prague%'
)

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS owner_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

WHERE type = 'PO Box'

SELECT zip_code
FROM zip_code
WHERE type = 'PO Box'
  AND county = 'San Juan Municipio'
  AND state = 'Puerto Rico'

SELECT event_name AS game
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.cost > 50

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN expense e
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'

SELECT major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Katy'
  AND member.link_to_major = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO'

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business'
  AND ma.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE maj.major_name = 'education'
  AND maj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.remaining < 0 THEN e.event_id END) /
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS percentage
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT event_id, location, status
FROM event
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-11-01' AND '2020-03-31'

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50

SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name
FROM member
WHERE t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

SELECT (SUM(type = 'PO Box') * 100.0) / COUNT(zip_code) AS percentage
FROM zip_code

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name, e.location
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.remaining > 0

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name, e.event_date
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  AND x.cost > 50
  AND x.cost < 100

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS name,
                maj.major_name AS major
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE e.cost > 100

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = CAST(e.location AS INTEGER)
WHERE i.amount > 40

WITH qualified_members AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE e.link_to_member IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM expense e
JOIN qualified_members q ON e.link_to_member = q.member_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
ORDER BY e.cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(expense.cost) / COUNT(event.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE member.position <> 'Member'

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
  AND ex.cost < (
      SELECT SUM(ex2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
      FROM expense ex2
      JOIN budget b2 ON ex2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
      JOIN event e2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
      WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
  )

SELECT
    (SUM(ex.cost) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting'), 0) AS percentage
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT b.budget_id, b.category, MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies'
GROUP BY b.budget_id, b.category
ORDER BY max_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
                m.phone AS contact_number
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT
    (SUM(z.state = 'New Jersey') * 1.0 / COUNT(m.position = 'Member'))
    -
    (SUM(z.state = 'Vermont') * 1.0 / COUNT(m.position = 'Member')) AS percentage_difference
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code

SELECT m.major_name, m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       e.cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m
  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

SELECT member.last_name, member.phone
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education'

SELECT b.category, b.amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'January Speaker'

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Food'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '9/9/2019'

SELECT b.category
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b
  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters'

SELECT
  m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
  mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj
  ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary'

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND m.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       m.position
FROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z
  ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.city = 'Lincolnton'
  AND z.state = 'North Carolina'
  AND z.zip_code = 28092
